csv_project_name: P3 For Aerospace and Defense Related Enterprises
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Raton, New Mexico, USA, ( City ) is an ideal location for aerospace-, space-, and defense-related enterprises and seeks proposals from professionals, businesses, and other potential tenants interested in occupying or securing another role in relation to part or all of a City-owned 17,000 square-foot armory building, 4,000 square-foot airplane hangar, and a 200-acre plot of land near the Raton Municipal/Crews Field Airport (RTN/KRTN), Interstate 25, and U.S. Highways 64 and 87 in northern New Mexico. The City of Raton, New Mexico, USA ("City") has a portfolio of properties suitable for aerospace, space, and defense enterprises and seeks proposals from qualified public, private, and nonprofit entities ("Offeror or Offerors") interested in locating, relocating, or expanding to a portion or the entirety of a former armory building (Exhibit A); an aircraft hangar (Exhibit B); and/or 200-acres of flat, expansive, and development-ready land (Exhibit C).
